profile.name: Eurotherm 2408 温度过程控制器
profile.description: Eurotherm 2408 是一款面板安装式温度/过程控制器，用于实验室和工业加热系统的温度调节。它可读取温度传感器信号，并通过设定值、PID 参数、斜坡速率、手动/自动模式和功率输出等功能对炉体、加热器或工艺过程进行闭环控制。
profile.description_en: The Eurotherm 2408 is a panel-mounted temperature/process controller used to regulate heating systems in laboratories and industrial setups. It reads temperature sensor signals and provides closed-loop control of furnaces, heaters, or thermal processes through setpoint control, PID tuning, ramp rate settings, manual/automatic modes, and power output adjustment.

The Eurotherm 2408 is a panel-mounted temperature/process controller used to regulate heating systems in laboratories and industrial setups. It reads temperature sensor signals and provides closed-loop control of furnaces, heaters, or thermal processes through setpoint control, PID tuning, ramp rate settings, manual/automatic modes, and power output adjustment.
